text:
elenacsm: Heads-up: client HelioWorks (mid-market, onboarded 6 weeks) reports a steep drop in reporting activity over last 2 weeks. CSAT follow-up = 6/10. Customer comment: 'scheduled exports missing P&L fields'. Looks like a combo of product gap + enablement.

rob_success: Thanks Elena. Any open tickets or error spikes?

elenacsm: One support case (ID 90234) for missing columns in CSV exports, and a spike in scheduled job failures in our metrics dashboard. No schema changes on their side.

sam_onboard: I can run a focused 30-min workshop for their finance admins this week. Recommend inviting product PM and eng oncall for live repro. Also can provide a short export-checklist template.

elenacsm: Good. Proposed quick action plan (48h triage -> 7d enablement -> 21d checkpoint). Lightweight checklist below.

- Triage call within 48h: CS + Eng oncall + PM + customer admins
- Customer to upload 3 example exported CSVs and the scheduled job IDs
- Support to reproduce missing columns in staging and attach repro to ticket 90234
- Provide short-term workaround: export-transformation script + mapping doc
- Push in-app help banner linking to booking + KB
- Run 30-min enablement session (recorded) within 7 days
- Weekly health check (exports processed, scheduled job success rate, mini NPS) for 3 weeks
- If metrics not recovered by day 21 -> escalate to AE: offer extended onboarding or credit

tara_support: I've added notes and uploaded the sample CSVs to ticket 90234. Included repro steps and a quick Python transform script as stopgap. Marked ticket high priority.

infra_bot: Alert: scheduled-job-failures increased for HelioWorks. Linked to ticket 90234.

sam_onboard: I'll author the workshop slides and the one-page recovery plan. Will include a section "what success looks like" so AE has negotiation ammo.

rob_success: Define measurable success for the 21-day checkpoint?

elenacsm: Success criteria: (1) export job success rate >= 90% OR signed adoption recovery plan; (2) no open reporting bugs for customer OR mitigation accepted; (3) post-workshop NPS >= 7 or AE sign-off.

rob_success: Sounds good. If unmet, AE to propose 1-month credit or extra SOW hours for migrations.

elenacsm: I'll schedule triage and draft the in-app banner copy. ETA 24h for banner and triage invite.

tara_support: Confirmed ticket label and priority. Will update with repro link once staging reproduction complete.

sam_onboard: Calendar invite created: HelioWorks - Reporting Workshop (in 40 hours). Internal 15-min 'next steps' after session.

elenacsm: Posting banner draft here for quick review: "Having trouble with Scheduled Reports? Join our quick workshop to restore exports and map your finance fields. Book a slot: [link]"

rob_success: :thumbsup: All in for triage.

tara_support: :thumbsup:

sam_onboard: :thumbsup: I'll drop recording and the recovery one-pager in this thread after the workshop.

elenacsm: After triage we'll capture a short product-feedback list for roadmap: CSV robustness, scheduled retry logic, and export field mapping UI. AE wants a one-page exec summary ready if needed.

rob_success: Keep me posted.
